title: Original database benchmark
content: Database latency exceeded the target before the decision.

title: Stale profile incident
content: Repeated stale profile incidents contradicted the assumption that profile updates are infrequent.

title: Distributed invalidation cost increased
content: Distributed Redis invalidation increased operational cost and weakened the manageable invalidation constraint.

title: New database optimization benchmark
content: A new benchmark supersedes the original evidence: database optimization now meets the latency target without caching.

title: Rename test helpers
content: Routine refactoring of unrelated test utilities.
